newsitem.title: FRANCE: Axa has no plans to sell DLJ, Axa Equity - paper.
newsitem.headline: Axa has no plans to sell DLJ, Axa Equity - paper.

text.p: Axa-UAP chairman Claude Bebear said in a newspaper interview that the group had no plan to sell Donaldson Lufkin & Jenrette (DLJ), the investment bank of Axa's U.S. subsidiary Equitable.
"DLJ, the investment bank of our U.S. subsidiary Equitable, is not for sale," Bebear told La Tribune.

He also said he preferred to link up UAP's Sun Life to Axa Equity and Law rather than sell the latter. "We receive offers regularly but our preference would be to bring Sun Life and Axa Equity and Law together...despite the restructuring costs that would entail," he said.
Rumours of a sale of DLJ, Sun Life or Axa Equity and Law have circulated in the markets since the recent merger of Axa and UAP.
